instagram.note_confusion: Booksy lista como instagramLink https://www.instagram.com/Eme.extensionesdepestanas/, y el bio de @miami.browslashes dice 'CEO @eme.extensionesdepestanas'. VERIFICADO que @eme.extensionesdepestanas es una cuenta DISTINTA: 61,150 seguidores, verificada, nombre 'CEJAS, PESTANAS Y MAS', bio dice horario 'Mar-Sab en Magdalena & La Molina' (Lima, Peru) y su link de bio es http://www.eme-web.com/ -- el mismo dominio que la tarea advirtio NO confundir con este negocio de Coral Gables. Conclusion: eme.extensionesdepestanas es la marca/academia internacional de la misma dueña (Emely Cieza) con sede en Peru, NO el estudio de Coral Gables. Se uso @miami.browslashes como IG operativo real de este negocio.

reviews.name: Fiorella G.
reviews.text: I'm completely in love with my results! 😍 I got powder brows and lip blushing done, and I honestly have no words to describe how happy and grateful I am.

reviews.name: Gabrielle M.
reviews.text: Emely is so sweet and very skilled. I got eyebrow threading and a lash lift and I could not be happier!

reviews.name: Caroly O.
reviews.text: I can't recommend her enough! She's truly great at what she does incredibly talented, detail oriented, and clearly passionate about her job.

reviews.name: Alexis H.
reviews.text: I have been going to Emely for the past year getting volume lashes. She does the best job! My real lashes are healthy.

reviews.name: Alejandra S.
reviews.text: If you're looking for a place that not only makes your lashes look amazing but also makes you feel cared for from the moment you walk in, this is it.

reviews.text: OBSESSED with my new lashes and brows! The experience was incredible, but the results are even better. 10/10 recommend! 🤩
